title: Your sign is a character
lines: Aries is the Pioneer. Scorpio is the Alchemist. Pisces is the Mystic.
Every one has a gift and a shadow.
caption:
Your zodiac archetype: the twelve signs as characters. ✦

◆ Aries: The Pioneer
◆ Taurus: The Gardener
◆ Gemini: The Messenger
◆ Cancer: The Nurturer
◆ Leo: The Sovereign
◆ Virgo: The Healer
◆ Libra: The Diplomat
◆ Scorpio: The Alchemist
◆ Sagittarius: The Seeker
◆ Capricorn: The Elder
◆ Aquarius: The Visionary
◆ Pisces: The Mystic

Each one has a gift and a shadow. Which one is yours?
